`digirain`
==========

Digital rain terminal animation

Usage
-----

```
digirain.exe [OPTIONS]
```

### Options ###

#### `-n`, `--iter <ITER>` ####

Number of iterations to run.

If absent, the program will run indefinitely until interrupted.

#### `-i`, `--interactive` ####

Wait for keypress between frames.

If set, the board will render one frame at a time and wait for the user to press Enter before proceeding to the next
frame. This is incompatible with the `--wait` option.

#### `-w`, `--wait <WAIT>` ####

Delay between frames in milliseconds.

If set, the program will wait for the specified number of milliseconds between rendering each frame. If set to 0, the
program will render frames as fast as possible. This option is incompatible with the `--interactive` option.

*default: 32*

#### `-a`, `--alphabet <ALPHABET>` ####

Alphabet file to use.

This should be a plain text file containing the possible characters to use in the effect. The predefined options
"ascii", "cp850", and "droplets" are also available.

If absent, a default alphabet of miscellaneous Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, punctuation, currency, control picture, and
dingbat characters will be used.

#### `-l`, `--lifespan <LIFESPAN>` ####

How long each character lives (in frames)

*default: 8*

#### `-T`, `--max-trail <MAX_TRAIL>` ####

Maximum trail length for each stream

*default: 32*

#### `-t`, `--min-trail <MIN_TRAIL>` ####

Minimum trail length for each stream

*default: 8*

#### `-p`, `--spawnprob <SPAWNPROB>` ####

Probability of spawning a new stream in each cell per frame

*default: 0.5*

#### `-m`, `--mutateprob <MUTATEPROB>` ####

Probability of mutating an existing character in each cell per frame

*default: 15*

#### `-c`, `--color <COLOR>` ####

Color of the rain

*possible values: black, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, white, cycle, random*

#### `-W`, `--warmup <WARMUP>` ####

Number of frames to "warm up" the effect before reaching full spawn probability

*default: 192*

#### `-F`, `--fullwidth` ####

Layout the characters using fullwidth glyphs

#### `-t`, `--frames <FRAMES>` ####

Total number of frames to render

#### `-h`, `--help` ####

Print help (see a summary with `-h`)

#### `-V`, `--version` ####

Print version
